snippet.title: Scramble Knights Online - Official Release Date Trailer | ID@Xbox Fall 2026
snippet.description:
Get a peek at gameplay and your adventure in this latest trailer for Scramble Knights Online. Adventure together with your friends in this MMO-lite action RPG! Explore the shared online kingdom of Terracott as a knight-in-training. Work together to take on quests, conquer dungeons, slay monsters, discover rare loot, and return home to forge powerful new gear before setting out on your next quest. 

Scramble Knights Online will be available on Xbox Series X/S, PC, Cloud, and Game Pass on October 26, 2026.
